data.long_meaning: Khitish is a Sanskrit and Hindi name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kheta', which means 'strength' or 'power'. The name Khitish is believed to represent the lord of strength and power, and is often given to boys as a sign of their potential and resilience. The name Khitish carries the meaning “Lord of Strength” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Khitish usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of strength and live with faith, good character and purpose.

The name Khitish is believed to bring blessings of strength, power, and protection, and is a reminder of the inner power that resides within us all.
